news.title: Three WashU scholars were Rhodes finalists
news.summary_en: WashU senior Romen Der Manuelian and two recent alumni, Mason Shaver and Vincent Tsay, were finalists for the prestigious Rhodes Scholarship.

news.title: Progress toward a blood test for CTE
news.summary_en: A new study by WashU Medicine researchers advances the goal of diagnosing and treating chronic traumatic encephalopathy, a degenerative brain disease linked to repeated blows to the head.
